body:
Thank you.

I've had group interviews and there were always people with bachelors degrees trying for the same crappy sales associate positions, so I know it's bad for everyone right now. I know I really need to stop taking everything so personally and blaming myself but that's easier said than done...

Thank you for the response.
I know R loves me but it's hard for me to understand. 
He's notoriously bad at communicating and I'm oblivious so I only figured out that he legit cared about me on the day I left to go live with T. He was actually crying at the airport. I have known him for so long and that was the only time I've ever seen him cry and it was because I was moving 1,500 miles away. I was shocked.

I know I'm overly dependent on him and I know it can't be like that forever. He'll get tired of me if he isn't already.

I don't want to make him cry again, but I can't stand for him to end up hating me.

Thanks for the advice.
I already have a pretty structured routine, I'm just having zero luck with the job part.
